source.text: Συνίστημι δὲ ὑμῖν Φοίβην τὴν ἀδελφὴν ἡμῶν, οὖσαν καὶ διάκονον τῆς ἐκκλησίας τῆς ἐν Κεγχρεαῖς, ἵνα αὐτὴν προσδέξησθε ἐν κυρίῳ ἀξίως τῶν ἁγίων, καὶ παραστῆτε αὐτῇ ἐν ᾧ ἂν ὑμῶν χρῄζῃ πράγματι, καὶ γὰρ αὐτὴ προστάτις πολλῶν ἐγενήθη καὶ ἐμοῦ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: I commend now to you Phoebe the sister of us, being also servant of the church the [one] in Cenchreae, \v 2 that her you may receive in [the] Lord worthily of the holy [ones], and may stand by her in whatever of you she may need matter, also for she patron of many became and of me myself.

en.L: Now I commend to you Phoebe our sister, who is also a deacon of the church in Cenchreae, \v 2 so that you may receive her in [the] Lord in a way worthy of the holy ones, and stand by her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself has also been a patron of many, and of me myself.
en.B: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a deacon of the church in Cenchreae. \v 2 I ask you to welcome her in the Lord in the way God's holy people should, and to stand by her in anything she may need from you. She has been a patron to many, and to me as well.
en.R: I want to introduce our sister Phoebe to you. She is a deacon who serves the church in Cenchreae. \v 2 Please welcome her as one who belongs to the Lord, in the way God's people should welcome each other. Help her with anything she needs from you. She has used what she has to support and protect many people, and she has done that for me too.

es.L: Ahora bien, {{plural_you:les|os}} recomiendo a Febe, nuestra hermana, que es también diaconisa de la iglesia que está en Cencrea, \v 2 para que la {{plural_you:reciban|recibáis}} en [el] Señor de una manera digna de los santos, y la {{plural_you:respalden|respaldéis}} en cualquier asunto en que precise de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, porque también ella ha sido benefactora de muchos, y de mí mismo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} recomiendo a nuestra hermana Febe, diaconisa de la iglesia de Cencrea. \v 2 {{plural_you:Les|Os}} pido que la {{plural_you:reciban|recibáis}} en el Señor como corresponde al pueblo santo de Dios, y que la {{plural_you:respalden|respaldéis}} en todo lo que necesite de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Ella ha sido benefactora de muchos, y también mía.
es.R: Quiero presentar{{plural_you:les|os}} a nuestra hermana Febe. Es diaconisa y sirve a la iglesia de Cencrea. \v 2 Por favor, {{plural_you:recíbanla|recibidla}} como a alguien que pertenece al Señor, de la manera en que los que forman el pueblo de Dios deben recibirse unos a otros. {{plural_you:Ayúdenla|Ayudadla}} en todo lo que necesite de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Ella ha usado lo que tiene para apoyar y proteger a muchas personas, y también lo ha hecho conmigo.

sw.L: Basi ninawapendekezea Fibi dada yetu, ambaye pia ni shemasi wa kanisa lililo katika Kenkrea, \v 2 ili mumpokee katika Bwana kwa namna inayostahili watakatifu, na msimame naye katika jambo lolote analohitaji kutoka kwenu, kwa maana yeye mwenyewe pia amekuwa mfadhili wa wengi, na wangu mimi mwenyewe.
sw.B: Ninawapendekezea dada yetu Fibi, shemasi wa kanisa la Kenkrea. \v 2 Nawaomba mumpokee katika Bwana kama inavyowapasa watakatifu wa Mungu, na msimame naye katika lolote analohitaji kutoka kwenu. Yeye amekuwa mfadhili wa watu wengi, na wangu pia.
sw.R: Nataka kumtambulisha kwenu dada yetu Fibi. Yeye ni shemasi anayelitumikia kanisa la Kenkrea. \v 2 Tafadhali mpokeeni kama mtu aliye wa Bwana, kwa namna watu wa Mungu wanavyopaswa kupokeana. Msaidieni katika lolote analohitaji kutoka kwenu. Ametumia alicho nacho kuwasaidia na kuwalinda watu wengi, na amenifanyia hivyo mimi pia.

fr.L: Je vous recommande Phœbé, notre sœur, qui est aussi diacre de l’église de Cenchrées, \v 2 afin que vous l’accueilliez dans [le] Seigneur d’une manière digne des saints, et que vous l’assistiez en toute affaire où elle aurait besoin de vous, car elle-même aussi a été la bienfaitrice de beaucoup, et de moi-même.
fr.B: Je vous recommande notre sœur Phœbé, diacre de l’église de Cenchrées. \v 2 Je vous demande de l’accueillir dans le Seigneur comme il convient au peuple saint de Dieu, et de l’assister en tout ce dont elle pourrait avoir besoin de votre part. Elle a été la bienfaitrice de beaucoup, et de moi aussi.
fr.R: Je veux vous présenter notre sœur Phœbé. Elle est diacre et sert l’église de Cenchrées. \v 2 Accueillez-la, s’il vous plaît, comme quelqu’un qui appartient au Seigneur, de la façon dont le peuple de Dieu doit s’accueillir. Aidez-la en tout ce dont elle a besoin. Elle a utilisé ce qu’elle avait pour soutenir et protéger beaucoup de gens, et elle l’a fait pour moi aussi.

ko.L: 겐그레아에 있는 교회의 집사이기도 한 우리 자매 뵈뵈를 여러분에게 추천합니다. \v 2 여러분은 성도들에게 합당하게 주님 안에서 그를 맞아들이고, 그가 여러분에게 무슨 일이든 도움이 필요하면 그를 도와주십시오. 그는 많은 사람의 후원자가 되었고, 나 자신의 [후원자도] 되었기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 나는 겐그레아 교회의 집사인 우리 자매 뵈뵈를 여러분에게 추천합니다. \v 2 여러분은 하나님의 거룩한 백성이 마땅히 해야 하는 대로 주님 안에서 그를 맞아 주십시오. 그리고 그가 여러분에게 무엇이 필요하든지 도와주십시오. 그는 많은 사람을 후원해 왔고, 나도 그의 후원을 받았습니다.
ko.R: 우리 자매 뵈뵈를 여러분에게 소개합니다. 그는 겐그레아 교회를 섬기는 집사입니다. \v 2 그를 주님께 속한 사람으로 맞아 주십시오. 하나님의 백성이 서로 맞아들이듯이 그를 맞아 주십시오. 그에게 필요한 것이 있으면 무엇이든 도와주십시오. 그는 자기가 가진 것으로 많은 사람을 돕고 보살펴 왔고, 나도 그렇게 도와주었습니다.

vi.L: Tôi giới thiệu với anh chị em Phê-bê, người chị em của chúng ta, cũng là chấp sự của Hội Thánh ở Sen-cơ-rê, \v 2 để anh chị em tiếp đón chị ấy trong Chúa một cách xứng đáng với các thánh đồ, và giúp đỡ chị ấy trong bất cứ việc gì chị ấy cần đến anh chị em, vì chính chị ấy cũng đã là người bảo trợ cho nhiều người, và cho chính tôi nữa.
vi.B: Tôi xin giới thiệu với anh chị em Phê-bê, người chị em của chúng ta, là chấp sự của Hội Thánh ở Sen-cơ-rê. \v 2 Tôi xin anh chị em tiếp đón chị trong Chúa như dân thánh nên tiếp đón nhau, và giúp đỡ chị trong bất cứ việc gì chị cần đến anh chị em. Chị đã là người bảo trợ cho nhiều người, và cho cả tôi nữa.
vi.R: Tôi muốn giới thiệu với anh chị em Phê-bê, người chị em của chúng ta. Chị là chấp sự phục vụ Hội Thánh ở Sen-cơ-rê. \v 2 Xin hãy tiếp đón chị như một người thuộc về Chúa, theo cách dân của Đức Chúa Trời nên tiếp đón nhau. Hãy giúp đỡ chị trong bất cứ việc gì chị cần. Chị đã dùng những gì mình có để nâng đỡ và bảo vệ nhiều người, và chị cũng đã làm như vậy cho tôi.

pt.L: Ora, recomendo a vocês Febe, a nossa irmã, que é também diaconisa da igreja em Cencreia, \v 2 para que vocês a recebam no Senhor de modo digno dos santos, e a ajudem em qualquer coisa de que ela precise de vocês, pois ela mesma também foi protetora de muitos, e de mim mesmo.
pt.B: Recomendo a vocês a nossa irmã Febe, diaconisa da igreja em Cencreia. \v 2 Peço que a recebam no Senhor como convém ao povo santo de Deus, e que a apoiem em tudo o que ela precisar de vocês. Ela tem sido benfeitora de muitos, e de mim também.
pt.R: Quero apresentar a vocês a nossa irmã Febe. Ela é diaconisa e serve a igreja em Cencreia. \v 2 Por favor, recebam Febe como alguém que pertence ao Senhor, do jeito que o povo de Deus deve receber uns aos outros. Ajudem Febe em tudo o que ela precisar de vocês. Ela tem usado o que tem para sustentar e proteger muitas pessoas, e fez isso por mim também.

am.L: በክንክራኦስ ያለችው ቤተ ክርስቲያን ዲያቆን የሆነችውን እኅታችንን ፌቤንን አደራ እላችኋለሁ፤ \v 2 ይኸውም ለቅዱሳን እንደሚገባ በጌታ እንድትቀበሏት፣ ከእናንተም በምትፈልገው በማንኛውም ነገር እንድትረዷት ነው፤ እርሷ ራሷ ለብዙዎች፣ ለእኔም ለራሴ ደጋፊ ሆናለችና።
am.B: በክንክራኦስ ያለችው ቤተ ክርስቲያን ዲያቆን የሆነችውን እኅታችንን ፌቤንን አደራ እላችኋለሁ። \v 2 ለእግዚአብሔር ቅዱሳን በሚገባ መንገድ በጌታ እንድትቀበሏት፣ ከእናንተም በምትፈልገው በማንኛውም ነገር ከጎኗ እንድትቆሙ እለምናችኋለሁ። እርሷ ለብዙዎች ደጋፊ ሆናለች፤ ለእኔም እንዲሁ።
am.R: እኅታችንን ፌቤንን ላስተዋውቃችሁ እወዳለሁ። እርሷ በክንክራኦስ ያለችውን ቤተ ክርስቲያን የምታገለግል ዲያቆን ናት። \v 2 የጌታ እንደ ሆነች አድርጋችሁ ተቀበሏት፤ የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ እርስ በርሱ ሊቀባበል በሚገባው መንገድ ተቀበሏት። ከእናንተ በምትፈልገው በማንኛውም ነገር እርዷት። ያላትን ተጠቅማ ብዙ ሰዎችን ደግፋለች፤ ጠብቃለችም፤ ለእኔም እንዲሁ አድርጋልኛለች።

ru.L: Представляю же вам Фиву, нашу сестру, служительницу церкви в Кенхреях, \v 2 чтобы вы приняли её в Господе, как подобает святым, и помогли ей, в каком деле она будет нуждаться в вас, ведь и она стала покровительницей многих и меня самого.
ru.B: Представляю вам нашу сестру Фиву, диакониссу церкви в Кенхреях. \v 2 Прошу вас принять её в Господе так, как подобает Божьему святому народу, и помогать ей во всём, в чём она будет нуждаться. Она была покровительницей многих, и меня тоже.
ru.R: Я хочу познакомить вас с нашей сестрой Фивой. Она диаконисса, которая служит церкви в Кенхреях. \v 2 Пожалуйста, примите её как ту, кто принадлежит Господу, так, как Божий народ должен принимать друг друга. Помогайте ей во всём, что ей понадобится от вас. Она использовала то, что у неё есть, чтобы поддерживать и защищать многих людей, и меня тоже.

hi.L: मैं तुमसे हमारी बहन फ़ीबे की सिफ़ारिश करता हूँ, जो किंख्रिया की कलीसिया की सेविका भी है, \v 2 कि तुम उसे प्रभु में, जैसा पवित्र जनों के योग्य है, ग्रहण करो, और जिस किसी बात में उसे तुमसे ज़रूरत हो, उसकी सहायता करो; क्योंकि वह भी बहुतों की संरक्षिका रही है, और मेरी भी।
hi.B: मैं तुमसे हमारी बहन फ़ीबे की सिफ़ारिश करता हूँ, जो किंख्रिया की कलीसिया की सेविका है। \v 2 मेरी विनती है कि तुम उसे प्रभु में वैसे ही स्वीकार करो जैसे परमेश्वर के पवित्र लोगों को करना चाहिए, और जिस किसी बात में उसे तुम्हारी ज़रूरत हो, उसका साथ दो। वह बहुतों की संरक्षिका रही है, और मेरी भी।
hi.R: मैं चाहता हूँ कि तुम हमारी बहन फ़ीबे से मिलो। वह किंख्रिया की कलीसिया में सेवा का काम करती है। \v 2 कृपया उसे ऐसे अपनाओ जैसे प्रभु के किसी जन को अपनाया जाता है, जैसे परमेश्वर के लोगों को एक दूसरे को अपनाना चाहिए। उसे तुमसे जो भी चाहिए, उसमें उसकी मदद करो। उसने अपना धन और अपना प्रभाव बहुत लोगों की सहायता और रक्षा में लगाया है, और मेरे लिए भी ऐसा किया है।

uk.L: Рекомендую ж вам Фіву, нашу сестру, яка є також дияконісою церкви в Кенхреях, \v 2 щоб ви прийняли її в Господі гідно святих і допомогли їй у всякій справі, у якій вона потребуватиме вас, бо й вона сама була покровителькою багатьох, і мене самого.
uk.B: Рекомендую вам нашу сестру Фіву, дияконісу церкви в Кенхреях. \v 2 Прошу вас прийняти її в Господі так, як годиться святим, і підтримати її в усьому, чого вона від вас потребуватиме. Вона була покровителькою для багатьох, і для мене теж.
uk.R: Я хочу представити вам нашу сестру Фіву. Вона дияконіса, яка служить церкві в Кенхреях. \v 2 Будь ласка, прийміть її як ту, що належить Господу, так, як Божий народ має приймати одне одного. Допоможіть їй у всьому, що їй від вас потрібно. Вона своїми статками підтримувала й захищала багатьох людей, і мене теж.

ja.L: さて、ケンクレアイにある教会の執事でもある、わたしたちの姉妹フィベを、あなたがたに推薦します。\v 2 あなたがたが主にあって、聖なる者たちにふさわしく彼女を迎え、彼女があなたがたに必要とするどんな事においても、彼女を助けるためです。実に、彼女自身も多くの人の後ろ盾となり、わたし自身の[後ろ盾]にもなったのです。
ja.B: ケンクレアイの教会の執事で、わたしたちの姉妹であるフィベを、あなたがたに推薦します。\v 2 どうか、主に結ばれた者として、神の聖なる民にふさわしいしかたで彼女を迎え、彼女があなたがたに何か必要とすることがあれば、助けてあげてください。彼女は多くの人の後ろ盾となってきました。わたしもその一人です。
ja.R: わたしたちの姉妹フィベを、みなさんに紹介します。フィベは、ケンクレアイの教会で執事として仕えています。\v 2 どうか、主と一つにされた人として、神の民にふさわしく、フィベを迎えてください。みなさんに何か助けてほしいことがあれば、手を貸してあげてください。フィベは、自分の持っているものを使って、多くの人を支え、守ってきました。わたしもその一人です。

decisions.choice: a letter of recommendation for Phoebe, who probably carried the letter
decisions.reason: "I commend" is the language of a letter of recommendation, which introduced a traveler to people who did not yet know her and asked them to receive her. Paul puts Phoebe first among all the names, and it is likely that she carried the letter to Rome, though the letter does not say so.

decisions.choice: Cenchreae, the eastern port of Corinth
decisions.reason: Cenchreae was a harbor town a few miles east of Corinth, on the Aegean side. Paul most likely wrote Romans from Corinth (see verse 23), so Phoebe belonged to a church near him.

decisions.choice: deacon: a recognized role of service in the church at Cenchreae
alternatives: servant: a general word for anyone who serves
decisions.reason: διάκονος means one who serves, and Paul uses it of himself, of Apollos and of Christ (15:8). Here it is tied to a particular church, "of the church in Cenchreae", which suggests a known role there, as in Philippians 1:1 and 1 Timothy 3:8-12, where the same word names an office. The word has the same form for a man or a woman. What a deacon did in a church this early is not known in detail; it may have included practical care, teaching or carrying messages. Others read the word here in its general sense: Phoebe served the church.

decisions.choice: receive her as believers should receive a fellow believer
alternatives: receive her as one worthy of the holy ones
decisions.reason: "In the Lord" means as a fellow member of the Lord's people, and "worthily of the holy ones" means in the way that befits God's people. The phrase is about how the readers welcome her, not about her worth.

decisions.choice: patron, benefactor: one who used her means and standing to support and protect others
decisions.reason: προστάτις is the feminine of a word for a protector or patron, someone of means who gave money, hospitality and legal or social protection to others. Paul says she has been this to many and to him. A related verb means "to lead" (12:8), so some read it as a position of leadership; but leading Paul himself is unlikely, and "helper" is too weak for a word used of patrons.

decisions.choice: the purpose clause becomes a request: I ask you to welcome her (B); Please welcome her (R)
alternatives: so that you may receive her
decisions.reason: In Greek the request hangs on "I commend" as its purpose. Balanced and Readable start a new sentence and make it a plain request, which is what the purpose clause asks for.

decisions.choice: the holy ones (L); God's holy people (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:7 and Philippians 4:21: "saint" now usually means an exceptionally holy person, but Paul means every believer, set apart as God's own.

decisions.choice: She has used what she has to support and protect many people
decisions.reason: Readable explains "patron" (meaning decision m5), a word many young readers do not know.

As throughout Romans (see 1:1), each plural "you" and its verb is a reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain). Chapter 16 is mostly the plural command "Saluden" / "Saludad".

Spanish nouns for an office mark gender, and "diaconisa" is the usual feminine of "diácono". The Greek uses one form for a man or a woman, so a reviewer may prefer "la diácono". "Servidora" would give the general sense that meaning decision m3 sets aside.

"Patrona" now means an employer or a patron saint, and "protectora" leaves out her giving. "Benefactora" names someone who uses her means for others, as meaning decision m5 describes; Readable explains it, as the English does.

"Shemasi" is the Swahili church word for a deacon, and it has no masculine or feminine form, like the Greek. "Mtumishi" (servant) would give the general sense that meaning decision m3 sets aside. A reviewer should check that "shemasi" reads naturally of a woman.

"Mfadhili" is a benefactor or sponsor, someone who supports others from his or her own means, which is what a patron was (meaning decision m5). "Msaidizi" (helper) is the word the meaning decision calls too weak.

decisions.choice: diacre (a woman: "une diacre" is implied by "qui", "elle")
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as a recognized role of service in that church. "Servante" would hide the role; "diaconesse" in French now names a later order of women and is not the word Paul uses for men in the same role (Philippians 1:1). "Diacre" serves for a man or a woman.

The word is a patron who used her means and standing for others (meaning decision). French "patronne" now means an employer, so Literal and Balanced say "bienfaitrice"; Readable spells out what she did, as the English does.

decisions.choice: French forms of the names (for this chapter): Phœbé, Cenchrées, Prisca, Aquilas, Épaïnète, Marie, Urbain, Apellès, Aristobule, Hérodion, Narcisse, Tryphène, Tryphose, Asyncrite, Phlégon, Hermès, Philologue, Julie, Nérée, Timothée, Gaïus, Éraste; the others unchanged
decisions.reason: As the French style guide asks, names take their usual French form where French has one; Latin names without a current French form (Ampliatus, Rufus, Lucius, Tertius, Quartus) keep it.

decisions.choice: "뵈뵈", "겐그레아"; the names of chapter 16 in their Protestant Korean forms: 브리스가, 아굴라, 에배네도, 마리아, 안드로니고, 유니아, 암블리아, 우르바노, 스다구, 아벨레, 아리스도불로, 헤로디온, 나깃수, 드루배나, 드루보사, 버시, 루포, 아순그리도, 블레곤, 허메, 바드로바, 허마, 빌롤로고, 율리아, 네레오, 올름바, 사탄, 디모데, 누기오, 야손, 소시바더, 더디오, 가이오, 에라스도, 구아도; "아시아"
alternatives: 모든 이름의 원어 발음식 표기 (페베, 켕크레아이 ...)
decisions.reason: Names follow the established Protestant Korean forms (docs/korean-style.md section 5), so readers can find the same people in other Korean Bibles and reference works.

decisions.choice: "집사" at every level for the deacon
decisions.reason: A recognized role of service in the church at Cenchreae (meaning decision, footnoted). "집사" is the Korean church word for that role, as the English says "deacon"; "일꾼" would make it general help.

decisions.choice: "후원자" (L, B); "자기가 가진 것으로 돕고 보살피다" (R); "그" for Phoebe
decisions.reason: Patron, benefactor (meaning decision, footnoted). Korean "그" is used of a woman as well as a man; "그녀" sounds out of place read aloud (as in Colossians 4:15). "자매" says she is a woman.

decisions.choice: "문안하십시오" (L, B); "안부를 전해 주십시오" (R) for the greetings of verses 3-16; "문안합니다" (L, B) / "안부를 전합니다" (R) for those who greet them in verses 16-23
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 4: "문안하다" is the formal word for greetings in a letter; Readable uses the everyday words, as the English Readable keeps "greet" plain.

decisions.choice: Names in this chapter in Protestant transliterations: Phê-bê, Sen-cơ-rê, Bê-rít-ca, A-qui-la, Ê-bai-nết, A-si, Ma-ri, An-trô-ni-cơ, Giu-ni-a, Am-li-a-tu, Ước-banh, Ếch-ta-chi, A-be-lơ, A-rích-tô-bu, Hê-rô-đi-ôn, Nạt-xít, Tri-phê-na, Tri-phô-sa, Bẹt-si-đơ, Ru-phu, A-sin-cơ-rít, Phơ-lê-gôn, Hẹt-me, Ba-trô-ba, Hẹt-ma, Phi-lô-lô-gơ, Giu-li, Nê-rê, Ô-lim, Ti-mô-thê, Lu-si-út, Gia-sôn, Sô-si-ba-tê, Tẹt-tiu, Gai-út, Ê-rát, Qua-đơ-tu
decisions.reason: Names follow the Protestant tradition the style guide sets for the whole translation; "Ti-mô-thê" and "Ru-phu" are the forms already used in the Vietnamese Colossians and Mark. Most of these names occur only here, and some forms were drafted from memory of the traditional version or transliterated from the Greek (Am-li-a-tu, Tri-phê-na, Tri-phô-sa in particular): a reviewer should check each against the tradition.

The meaning decision reads the word here as a recognized role of service in the church at Cenchreae (footnoted). Elsewhere the word is "người phục vụ" (15:8; Colossians 1:23), but "chấp sự" is the Vietnamese church name for this office and says that she held it. "Nữ chấp sự" would add a distinction the Greek does not make.

decisions.choice: "người bảo trợ" (L, B); "nâng đỡ và bảo vệ" (R)
decisions.reason: A patron used her means and standing to support and protect others (m5, footnoted). "Người bảo trợ" says that; "người giúp đỡ" would make her only a helper.

Vietnamese must choose a word for her, which the Greek does not give. Paul calls her "our sister", so "chị", the respectful word for a sister in the faith; women Paul greets in this chapter are "chị" and men "anh" where a pronoun is needed, and Rufus's mother "bà".

Portuguese must give the word a gender. "Diaconisa" is the established Portuguese word for a woman deacon and says, as the English "deacon" does, that Phoebe had a recognized role in that church (m3); "serva" would lose that, and "diácona" is still rare. Some readers may take "diaconisa" to mean a separate order for women, which the Greek (the same word as for men) does not imply.

"Patrona" in Brazil suggests a patron saint or an employer. Literal says "protetora" and Balanced "benfeitora", which together cover the support and protection m5 describes; Readable spells it out, as the English Readable does.

The meaning decision takes diakonos here as a recognised role in the church at Cenchreae, so the church word "ዲያቆን" is used, with the feminine verb ("የሆነችውን", "ናት"). A reviewer may prefer a feminine form such as "ዲያቆናዊት".

alternatives: a spelling closer to the Greek or Latin form
decisions.reason: Established Amharic Bible forms; "ክንክራኦስ" is also the form in the Amharic draft of Acts 18:18.

Diakonos here names a recognized role of service in the church at Cenchreae (meaning decision m3). Literal says "служительница", the feminine of the general word; Balanced and Readable use "диаконисса", the Russian church word for a woman deacon.
Prostatis is a patron or benefactor who used her means and standing to protect others (meaning decision m5); "помощница" would make her role smaller than the Greek word does.

Diakonos here names a recognized role of service in the church (meaning decision m3). "सेविका" is the feminine of "सेवक", the guide's word for diakonos (section 7b), so the role keeps its link to the same word in 13:4 and 15:8; the English loanword "डीकन" is not general Hindi.
A patron used her means and standing to support and protect others (meaning decision m5); "संरक्षिका" says protector and supporter, where "सहायिका" would make her only a helper. Readable explains it.
Devanagari has no capital letters, and "मसीह" is both the name and the word Messiah (style guide section 7), so neither English setting has anything to change in this file.

Names in Romans 16 take the traditional Ukrainian Bible forms in modern spelling (Фіва, Кенхреї). "Дияконіса" names a recognised role, as the English "deacon" does (meaning decision m3), where "служителька" would say only that she serves; the reading is uncertain.
Phoebe; Cenchreae is "ケンクレアイ". A transliteration of the Greek form of the name in the pattern of modern ecumenical Japanese usage; noted once where the name appears.

The word is tied to a particular church, which suggests a recognized role there (m3), as the English "deacon" says. "執事" is the Japanese church word for that role; the general "奉仕者" (used of Christ in 15:8) would hide it. The word has the same form for a woman, and Japanese "執事" is not marked for gender either.

decisions.choice: "後ろ盾" (L, B); "自分の持っているものを使って、多くの人を支え、守ってきました" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is used of a patron who gave money, hospitality and protection (m5). "後ろ盾" is someone whose standing and means support and shield others; "援助者" is too weak and "保護者" now suggests a parent or guardian. Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

source.text: Ἀσπάσασθε Πρίσκαν καὶ Ἀκύλαν τοὺς συνεργούς μου ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, οἵτινες ὑπὲρ τῆς ψυχῆς μου τὸν ἑαυτῶν τράχηλον ὑπέθηκαν, οἷς οὐκ ἐγὼ μόνος εὐχαριστῶ ἀλλὰ καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τῶν ἐθνῶν, καὶ τὴν κατ’ οἶκον αὐτῶν ἐκκλησίαν.

records.literal_gloss: Greet Prisca and Aquila the fellow workers of me in Christ Jesus, \v 4 who for the life of me the of themselves neck laid down, to whom not I alone give thanks but also all the churches of the Gentiles, \v 5 and the at house of them church.

en.L: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus, \v 4 who laid down their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks but also all the churches of the Gentiles; \v 5 and [greet] the church at their house.
en.B: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus. \v 4 They put their own necks on the line for my life, and it is not only I who thank them: all the churches of the Gentiles do too. \v 5 Greet also the church that meets in their house.
en.R: Greet Prisca and Aquila. They have worked with me for {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus. \v 4 They risked their own lives to save mine. I am thankful to them, and so are all the churches among people who are not Jews. \v 5 Also greet the church that meets in their home.

es.L: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a Prisca y a Aquila, mis colaboradores en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}}, \v 4 que por mi vida expusieron su propio cuello, a quienes no yo solo doy gracias, sino también todas las iglesias de los gentiles; \v 5 y [{{plural_you:saluden|saludad}}] a la iglesia [que está] en su casa.
es.B: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a Prisca y a Aquila, mis colaboradores en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}}. \v 4 Se jugaron el cuello por salvarme la vida, y no soy solo yo quien les está agradecido: también lo están todas las iglesias de los gentiles. \v 5 {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} también a la iglesia que se reúne en su casa.
es.R: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a Prisca y a Aquila. Han trabajado conmigo para {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}}. \v 4 Arriesgaron su propia vida para salvar la mía. Yo les estoy agradecido, y también todas las iglesias de los que no son judíos. \v 5 {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} además a la iglesia que se reúne en su hogar.

sw.L: Wasalimieni Priska na Akila, watenda kazi pamoja nami katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, \v 4 ambao kwa ajili ya uhai wangu waliweka chini shingo zao wenyewe, ambao si mimi peke yangu ninayewashukuru bali pia makanisa yote ya watu wa mataifa; \v 5 na [salimieni] kanisa lililo nyumbani mwao.
sw.B: Wasalimieni Priska na Akila, wafanyakazi wenzangu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu. \v 4 Waliweka shingo zao hatarini ili kuokoa maisha yangu, na si mimi peke yangu ninayewashukuru: makanisa yote ya watu wa mataifa yanawashukuru pia. \v 5 Salimieni pia kanisa linalokutana nyumbani mwao.
sw.R: Wasalimieni Priska na Akila. Wamefanya kazi pamoja nami kwa ajili ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu. \v 4 Walihatarisha maisha yao ili kuokoa maisha yangu. Ninawashukuru, na makanisa yote ya watu wasio Wayahudi yanawashukuru pia. \v 5 Pia salimieni kanisa linalokutana nyumbani kwao.

fr.L: Saluez Prisca et Aquilas, mes collaborateurs {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus, \v 4 qui pour ma vie ont exposé leur propre cou, [eux] à qui je ne suis pas seul à rendre grâce, mais aussi toutes les églises des nations ; \v 5 et [saluez] l’église [qui est] dans leur maison.
fr.B: Saluez Prisca et Aquilas, mes collaborateurs {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus. \v 4 Ils ont risqué leur tête pour me sauver la vie, et je ne suis pas le seul à leur être reconnaissant : toutes les églises des nations le sont aussi. \v 5 Saluez aussi l’église qui se réunit dans leur maison.
fr.R: Saluez Prisca et Aquilas. Ils ont travaillé avec moi pour le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus. \v 4 Ils ont risqué leur vie pour sauver la mienne. Je leur suis reconnaissant, et toutes les églises de ceux qui ne sont pas juifs le sont aussi. \v 5 Saluez aussi l’église qui se réunit chez eux.

ko.L: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 나의 동역자인 브리스가와 아굴라에게 문안하십시오. \v 4 그들은 내 목숨을 위하여 자기들의 목을 내놓았습니다. 나만 그들에게 감사하는 것이 아니라 이방 사람들의 모든 교회도 [감사합니다]. \v 5 그리고 그들의 집에 있는 교회에도 [문안하십시오].
ko.B: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 나와 함께 일한 브리스가와 아굴라에게 문안하십시오. \v 4 그들은 내 목숨을 구하려고 자기들의 목숨을 내걸었습니다. 그들에게 감사하는 사람은 나만이 아닙니다. 이방 사람들의 모든 교회도 그들에게 감사하고 있습니다. \v 5 그들의 집에서 모이는 교회에도 문안하십시오.
ko.R: 브리스가와 아굴라에게 안부를 전해 주십시오. 그들은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 위해 나와 함께 일했습니다. \v 4 그들은 내 목숨을 살리려고 자기들의 목숨을 걸었습니다. 나는 그들에게 감사하고, 유대인이 아닌 사람들의 모든 교회도 그들에게 감사합니다. \v 5 그들의 집에서 모이는 교회에도 안부를 전해 주십시오.

vi.L: Hãy chào Bê-rít-ca và A-qui-la, những bạn đồng lao của tôi trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu, \v 4 là những người đã đặt cổ mình xuống vì mạng sống tôi; không chỉ một mình tôi mà tất cả các Hội Thánh của dân ngoại đều cảm tạ họ, \v 5 và [hãy chào] Hội Thánh nhóm tại nhà họ.
vi.B: Xin chào thăm Bê-rít-ca và A-qui-la, những bạn cùng làm việc với tôi trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. \v 4 Họ đã liều mạng mình để cứu mạng sống tôi, và không chỉ tôi mà tất cả các Hội Thánh của dân ngoại cũng đều biết ơn họ. \v 5 Cũng xin chào thăm Hội Thánh nhóm họp tại nhà họ.
vi.R: Hãy chào Bê-rít-ca và A-qui-la. Họ đã cùng làm việc với tôi cho Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. \v 4 Họ đã liều mạng để cứu mạng tôi. Tôi biết ơn họ, và tất cả các Hội Thánh ở giữa những người không phải Do Thái cũng vậy. \v 5 Cũng hãy chào Hội Thánh nhóm họp tại nhà họ.

pt.L: Saúdem Prisca e Áquila, meus colaboradores {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus, \v 4 que pela minha vida expuseram o próprio pescoço, aos quais não só eu dou graças, mas também todas as igrejas das nações; \v 5 e [saúdem] a igreja que [se reúne] na casa deles.
pt.B: Saúdem Prisca e Áquila, meus colaboradores {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus. \v 4 Eles arriscaram o pescoço para salvar a minha vida, e não sou só eu que lhes agradeço: todas as igrejas dos não judeus também agradecem. \v 5 Saúdem também a igreja que se reúne na casa deles.
pt.R: Saúdem Prisca e Áquila. Eles trabalharam comigo para {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus. \v 4 Eles arriscaram a própria vida para salvar a minha. Eu sou grato a eles, e todas as igrejas formadas por não judeus também são. \v 5 Saúdem também a igreja que se reúne na casa deles.

am.L: {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ አብረውኝ የሚሠሩትን ጵርስቅላንና አቂላን ሰላም በሉ፤ \v 4 እነርሱ ስለ ሕይወቴ የገዛ አንገታቸውን አሳልፈው ሰጥተዋል፤ እኔ ብቻ ሳልሆን የአሕዛብ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ሁሉ ደግሞ ያመሰግኗቸዋል፤ \v 5 በቤታቸው ያለችውንም ቤተ ክርስቲያን [ሰላም በሉ]።
am.B: {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ አብረውኝ የሚሠሩትን ጵርስቅላንና አቂላን ሰላም በሉልኝ። \v 4 እነርሱ ስለ ሕይወቴ ሲሉ የገዛ አንገታቸውን ለአደጋ አጋልጠዋል፤ የማመሰግናቸው እኔ ብቻ አይደለሁም፤ የአሕዛብ አብያተ ክርስቲያናትም ሁሉ ያመሰግኗቸዋል። \v 5 በቤታቸው የምትሰበሰበውን ቤተ ክርስቲያንም ሰላም በሉልኝ።
am.R: ጵርስቅላንና አቂላን ሰላም በሉልኝ። እነርሱ {{christos:ለክርስቶስ|ለመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ ከእኔ ጋር አብረው ሠርተዋል። \v 4 የእኔን ሕይወት ለማዳን የገዛ ሕይወታቸውን ለአደጋ አጋልጠዋል። እኔ አመሰግናቸዋለሁ፤ አይሁድ ባልሆኑ ሕዝቦች መካከል ያሉት አብያተ ክርስቲያናትም ሁሉ ያመሰግኗቸዋል። \v 5 በቤታቸው የምትሰበሰበውን ቤተ ክርስቲያንም ሰላም በሉልኝ።

ru.L: Приветствуйте Приску и Акилу, моих сотрудников {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе, \v 4 которые за мою жизнь подставили свою шею, которых не только я благодарю, но и все церкви язычников, \v 5 и [приветствуйте] церковь в их доме.
ru.B: Приветствуйте Приску и Акилу, моих сотрудников {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе. \v 4 Они рисковали своей головой ради моей жизни, и не только я благодарен им: им благодарны и все церкви язычников. \v 5 Приветствуйте также церковь, которая собирается в их доме.
ru.R: Приветствуйте Приску и Акилу. Они трудились вместе со мной для {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} Иисуса. \v 4 Они рисковали своей жизнью, чтобы спасти мою. Я благодарен им, и все церкви среди людей из других народов тоже. \v 5 Приветствуйте также церковь, которая собирается в их доме.

hi.L: प्रिस्का और अक्विला को, जो मसीह यीशु में मेरे सहकर्मी हैं, नमस्कार कहो, \v 4 जिन्होंने मेरे प्राण के लिए अपनी गर्दन रख दी, और जिनका धन्यवाद केवल मैं ही नहीं, पर अन्यजातियों की सारी कलीसियाएँ भी करती हैं; \v 5 और उस कलीसिया को [नमस्कार कहो] जो उनके घर में है।
hi.B: प्रिस्का और अक्विला को नमस्कार कहो, जो मसीह यीशु में मेरे सहकर्मी हैं। \v 4 उन्होंने मेरे प्राण के लिए अपनी जान जोखिम में डाली, और केवल मैं ही उनका धन्यवाद नहीं करता: अन्यजातियों की सारी कलीसियाएँ भी करती हैं। \v 5 उस कलीसिया को भी नमस्कार कहो जो उनके घर में इकट्ठी होती है।
hi.R: प्रिस्का और अक्विला को नमस्कार कहना। उन्होंने मसीह यीशु के लिए मेरे साथ काम किया है। \v 4 उन्होंने मेरी जान बचाने के लिए अपनी जान ख़तरे में डाली। मैं उनका धन्यवाद करता हूँ, और ग़ैर-यहूदियों के बीच की सारी कलीसियाएँ भी उनका धन्यवाद करती हैं। \v 5 उस कलीसिया को भी नमस्कार कहना जो उनके घर में इकट्ठी होती है।

uk.L: Вітайте Приску й Акилу, моїх співпрацівників {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі, \v 4 які за моє життя поклали свої шиї, яким не тільки я дякую, а й усі церкви язичників, \v 5 і [вітайте] церкву, що в їхньому домі.
uk.B: Вітайте Приску й Акилу, моїх співпрацівників {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі. \v 4 Вони ризикували власними головами заради мого життя, і дякую їм не тільки я, а й усі церкви язичників. \v 5 Вітайте також церкву, яка збирається в їхньому домі.
uk.R: Привітайте Приску й Акилу. Вони працювали разом зі мною для {{christos:Христа|Месії}} Ісуса. \v 4 Вони ризикували своїм життям, щоб урятувати моє. Я вдячний їм, і так само всі церкви серед людей, які не є юдеями. \v 5 Привітайте також церкву, яка збирається в їхньому домі.

ja.L: {{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスにあるわたしの同労者、プリスカとアキラにあいさつしなさい。\v 4 彼らはわたしの命のために、自分たちの首を差し出しました。彼らには、わたしだけでなく、異邦人のすべての教会も感謝しています。\v 5 また、彼らの家にある教会にも[あいさつしなさい]。
ja.B: {{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスに結ばれたわたしの同労者、プリスカとアキラによろしく伝えてください。\v 4 二人は、わたしの命を守るために、自分たちの命を危険にさらしてくれました。二人に感謝しているのは、わたしだけではありません。異邦人のすべての教会も感謝しています。\v 5 また、二人の家に集まる教会にも、よろしく伝えてください。
ja.R: プリスカとアキラによろしく伝えてください。二人は、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスのために、わたしといっしょに働いてきました。\v 4 二人は、わたしを助けるために、自分たちの命をかけてくれました。わたしは二人に感謝しています。ユダヤ人でない人々の中にあるすべての教会も、感謝しています。\v 5 また、二人の家に集まっている教会にも、よろしく伝えてください。

decisions.choice: Prisca and Aquila, a Jewish couple who worked with Paul
decisions.reason: Acts calls her Priscilla, the familiar form of the name; Paul calls her Prisca (1 Corinthians 16:19, 2 Timothy 4:19). They left Rome when the emperor Claudius expelled the Jews, met Paul in Corinth and shared his trade of tentmaking, then worked with him in Ephesus (Acts 18:1-3, 18-26). Now they are back in Rome. Prisca is often named before her husband, which may mean she was the better known of the two.

decisions.choice: they risked their lives to save Paul
alternatives: they were literally threatened with execution
decisions.reason: "To lay down the neck" pictures offering one's neck to the sword: to risk death. When and where they did this is not said; it may have been in Ephesus, where Paul faced great danger (Acts 19:23-41, 1 Corinthians 15:32, 2 Corinthians 1:8-9).
Paul is the apostle to the Gentiles (11:13). The churches he founded among them owe their thanks to the couple who saved his life.

decisions.choice: a church that met in their house
decisions.reason: Early believers met in homes; there were no church buildings. "The church at their house" is the group of believers who met in Prisca and Aquila's home, as they had done in Ephesus (1 Corinthians 16:19). The names that follow in verses 10-15 may belong to other such groups in the city.
Paul writes the shorter form of her name. The levels keep his form; Priscilla is the name Acts uses for the same woman (meaning decision m1).
Title setting.
The Greek continues the list governed by "Greet" in verse 3; English needs the verb again after the long description in verse 4.
Readable says what "Gentiles" means, as in 1:16.
Spanish has its own idiom with the same image, "jugarse el cuello" (to stake one's neck), so Balanced can keep Paul's picture and still be plain Spanish.

decisions.choice: Msalimieni / Wasalimieni; salimieni for a church
decisions.reason: The plural command "greet" carries an object marker for the people greeted: "Msalimieni" for one person, "Wasalimieni" for two or more, and plain "salimieni" for a church. "Nisalimieni" (greet for me) is a common way to send greetings in Swahili, but it adds "for me", which the Greek does not have.

decisions.choice: l’église, lowercase, for each local congregation (for this chapter)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians, French writes "Église" with a capital for the whole people of God and "église" for one gathering of believers, such as a house church; here every church named is a local one.
Paul writes the short form of her name, "브리스가"; Acts 18 uses the longer "브리스길라"; the Korean keeps the form Paul writes, as the English keeps "Prisca".
They risked their lives to save Paul (meaning decision); Literal keeps the picture of the neck.

The Greek has the short form Prisca, which the English keeps. "Bê-rít-sin" is the familiar Protestant form of the longer Priscilla; "Bê-rít-ca" transliterates the name Paul wrote. A reviewer may prefer the familiar form.

decisions.choice: "Hãy chào" (L, R); "Xin chào thăm" (B) for "greet" through the chapter
decisions.reason: The forms of Colossians 4:15: the plain imperative at Literal and Readable, the courteous request at Balanced.

decisions.choice: "bạn đồng lao" (L); "bạn cùng làm việc" (B); "cùng làm việc với" (R) for fellow worker (also 16:9, 16:21)
decisions.reason: The forms of Colossians 4:11; "đồng nghiệp" is a colleague at work.
Laying down the neck is an idiom for risking one's life (m2); Literal keeps the picture, Balanced and Readable use the Vietnamese idiom.

Paul writes the short form of her name here (as in 1 Corinthians 16:19 and 2 Timothy 4:19), and the English keeps "Prisca"; Portuguese does the same, as Acts 18 has the longer "Priscila" where Luke writes it. The meaning note says they are the same woman.

decisions.choice: "ሰላም በሉ" (L); "ሰላም በሉልኝ" (greet for me, B, R) for 'Greet ...'
decisions.reason: "X-ን ሰላም በሉ" is the everyday Amharic way to send a greeting to someone. Balanced and Readable add the ending "-ልኝ" ('for me'), which is how a greeting sent through others is said; Literal keeps the bare imperative. The same holds through verses 3-16.

alternatives: a spelling closer to the Greek or Latin form
decisions.reason: The Greek has the short form Prisca; she is the Priscilla of Acts 18, where the Amharic has "ጵርስቅላ". The familiar Amharic form is kept so readers know her; "አቂላ" is Aquila, as in Acts.
Paul uses the short form Prisca; Acts 18 has the diminutive Priscilla, "Прискилла" in the Russian of Acts. The Russian follows the Greek of each book, as the English does.

decisions.choice: язычники (L, B); люди из других народов (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Romans term for the Gentiles, noted where it first appears in this chapter.
Paul writes the shorter form of her name, and each level keeps it; Acts calls the same woman "प्रिस्किल्ला" (meaning decision m1).
The ordinary Hindi way of sending a greeting through others; the same form is used through the list of greetings.
Paul writes the name Prisca (*Priska*); "Прискилла" is the diminutive Luke uses in Acts, and the style guide's form for that book.
One verb for *aspazomai* through the greetings of Romans 16; Readable uses the perfective imperative, the everyday way to ask someone to greet a person.

decisions.choice: "あいさつしなさい" (L); "よろしく伝えてください" (B, R)
alternatives: "あいさつしてください" at B
decisions.reason: The command "greet" runs through verses 3-16. Literal keeps it as a command; Balanced and Readable use the Japanese letter idiom for sending greetings to people the writer names, which is what the command asks the readers to do. "Greets you" (verses 16, 21-23) is "あなたがたにあいさつしています" (L) and "よろしくと言っています" (B, R).
Paul writes the short form of her name; "プリスキラ" is the form Acts uses for the same woman (m1).

decisions.choice: "自分たちの首を差し出しました" (L); "自分たちの命を危険にさらしてくれました" (B); "自分たちの命をかけてくれました" (R)
decisions.reason: The picture is offering one's neck to the sword: risking death (m2). Literal keeps it; Japanese "首をかける" usually means staking one's job, so Balanced and Readable say plainly that they risked their lives.

source.text: ἀσπάσασθε Ἐπαίνετον τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου, ὅς ἐστιν ἀπαρχὴ τῆς Ἀσίας εἰς Χριστόν.

records.literal_gloss: Greet Epaenetus the beloved of me, who is firstfruit of the Asia for Christ.

en.L: Greet Epaenetus my beloved, who is [the] firstfruits of Asia for {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, the first of the harvest for {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} in Asia.
en.R: Greet Epaenetus, my dear friend. He was the first person in the province of Asia to become a follower of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a Epeneto, mi amado, que es [la] primicia de Asia para {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a mi querido Epeneto, el primer fruto de la cosecha para {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} en Asia.
es.R: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a Epeneto, mi querido amigo. Fue la primera persona de la provincia de Asia que llegó a seguir {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}.

sw.L: Msalimieni Epaineto mpendwa wangu, ambaye ni malimbuko ya Asia kwa ajili ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Msalimieni rafiki yangu mpendwa Epaineto, wa kwanza wa mavuno kwa ajili ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} katika Asia.
sw.R: Msalimieni Epaineto, rafiki yangu mpendwa. Yeye alikuwa mtu wa kwanza katika jimbo la Asia kuwa mfuasi wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

fr.L: Saluez Épaïnète, mon bien-aimé, qui est [les] prémices de l’Asie pour {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.
fr.B: Saluez mon cher Épaïnète, le premier fruit de la moisson pour le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} en Asie.
fr.R: Saluez Épaïnète, mon cher ami. Il a été le premier de la province d’Asie à devenir disciple du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.

ko.L: 내가 사랑하는 에배네도에게 문안하십시오. 그는 아시아에서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 [드려진] 첫 열매입니다.
ko.B: 내가 사랑하는 친구 에배네도에게 문안하십시오. 그는 아시아에서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 돌아온 첫 열매입니다.
ko.R: 내가 사랑하는 친구 에배네도에게 안부를 전해 주십시오. 그는 아시아 지방에서 맨 처음으로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 믿은 사람입니다.

vi.L: Hãy chào Ê-bai-nết, người yêu dấu của tôi, là trái đầu mùa của A-si cho {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Xin chào thăm Ê-bai-nết, người bạn thân yêu của tôi, là người đầu tiên trong mùa gặt cho {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} tại A-si.
vi.R: Hãy chào Ê-bai-nết, người bạn thân yêu của tôi. Anh là người đầu tiên ở tỉnh A-si trở thành người theo {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.

pt.L: Saúdem Epêneto, meu amado, que é [a] primícia da Ásia para {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.
pt.B: Saúdem o meu querido amigo Epêneto, o primeiro fruto da colheita para {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} na Ásia.
pt.R: Saúdem Epêneto, meu querido amigo. Ele foi a primeira pessoa na província da Ásia a se tornar seguidor {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}.

am.L: {{christos:ለክርስቶስ|ለመሲሕ}} የእስያ የመጀመሪያ ፍሬ የሆነውን የምወደውን ኤጲኔጦስን ሰላም በሉ።

am.R: ውድ ወዳጄን ኤጲኔጦስን ሰላም በሉልኝ። እርሱ በእስያ ግዛት {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሕን}} የተከተለ የመጀመሪያው ሰው ነው።

ru.L: Приветствуйте Епенета, моего возлюбленного, который — начаток Азии для {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}.
ru.B: Приветствуйте моего дорогого друга Епенета, первый плод урожая для {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} в Азии.
ru.R: Приветствуйте Епенета, моего дорогого друга. Он был первым человеком в провинции Азия, кто стал последователем {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}.

hi.L: मेरे प्रिय इपैनितुस को नमस्कार कहो, जो मसीह के लिए आसिया का पहला फल है।
hi.B: मेरे प्यारे मित्र इपैनितुस को नमस्कार कहो, जो आसिया में मसीह के लिए पहली उपज है।
hi.R: मेरे प्यारे मित्र इपैनितुस को नमस्कार कहना। आसिया प्रदेश में मसीह का अनुयायी बननेवाला वह पहला व्यक्ति था।

uk.L: Вітайте Епенета, мого улюбленого, який є первістком Азії для {{christos:Христа|Месії}}.
uk.B: Вітайте мого дорогого друга Епенета, перший плід Азії для {{christos:Христа|Месії}}.
uk.R: Привітайте Епенета, мого дорогого друга. Він першим у провінції Азія став послідовником {{christos:Христа|Месії}}.

ja.L: わたしの愛するエパイネトにあいさつしなさい。彼はアジア州の、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}への初穂です。
ja.B: わたしの愛するエパイネトによろしく伝えてください。彼は、アジア州で{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}を信じた人々の初穂です。
ja.R: エパイネトによろしく伝えてください。わたしの親しい友です。彼は、アジア州で最初に{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}に従うようになった人です。

decisions.choice: firstfruits: the first convert, the first of a harvest still to come
alternatives: the first portion offered to God
decisions.reason: ἀπαρχή is the first part of a harvest, which was given to God (Leviticus 23:10). Paul uses it of the first converts in a region (1 Corinthians 16:15). It says Epaenetus was the first, and it hints that many more would follow.

decisions.choice: Asia: the Roman province in the west of what is now Turkey
decisions.reason: Asia was a Roman province with Ephesus as its chief city. Paul worked there for more than two years (Acts 19:10).

decisions.choice: beloved: a dear friend in the faith
decisions.reason: ἀγαπητός is "loved", here a warm term for a fellow believer, as in verses 8, 9 and 12.
"Beloved" is church language; "dear friend" says the same thing in everyday English.
The standard English spelling of the name, which keeps the Greek diphthong.
Title setting.

decisions.choice: "첫 열매" (L, B), as at 8:23; "맨 처음으로 믿은 사람" (R)
decisions.reason: The first convert, the first of a harvest still to come (meaning decision); Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "내가 사랑하는" (L); "내가 사랑하는 친구" (B, R), here and in verses 8, 9 and 12
decisions.reason: A dear friend in the faith (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "trái đầu mùa" (L), as in 8:23; "A-si" (L, B), "tỉnh A-si" (R)
decisions.reason: Firstfruits is the first convert, the first of a harvest still to come (m1). Asia is the Roman province (m2): "A-si" is the traditional form; "châu Á" would be heard as the continent, so Readable adds "tỉnh" (province).

decisions.choice: "người yêu dấu" (L); "người bạn thân yêu" (B, R) (also 16:8, 16:9, 16:12)
decisions.reason: Beloved is a dear friend in the faith (m3). Literal keeps "yêu dấu", as in Colossians 4:14; Balanced and Readable say "dear friend", as the English does.
"በኩር" is used of a firstborn child and would suggest the wrong picture. 'First fruit' keeps the harvest image: the first of many converts in Asia.
Firstfruits is the first of a harvest still to come (meaning decision m1); Readable says he was the first convert.
"Возлюблений" is Church Slavonic; Literal keeps one word for *agapētos*, Balanced and Readable say what it means, a dear friend in the faith. Used through Romans 16.

Names ending in -os drop the ending in this pattern (エパイネト, アンドロニコ, アンプリアト, ウルバノ, アリストブロ, ナルキソ, アシンクリト, フィロロゴ, ルキオ, ソシパトロ, テルティオ, ガイオ), except where a form with the ending is already settled for Romans (エラストス). A transliteration of the Greek form of the name in the pattern of modern ecumenical Japanese usage; noted once where the name appears.

decisions.choice: "愛する" (L, B), "親しい友" (R); "初穂" (L, B), "最初に……従うようになった人" (R)
decisions.reason: "Beloved" is a warm word for a fellow believer (m3); Readable says "親しい友", as in verses 8, 9 and 12. "初穂" is the first of the harvest given to God (m1), a word Japanese church readers know; Readable says what it means.

source.text: ἀσπάσασθε Μαριάμ, ἥτις πολλὰ ἐκοπίασεν εἰς ὑμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: Greet Mary, who much labored for you.

en.L: Greet Mary, who labored much for you.
en.B: Greet Mary, who has worked hard for you.
en.R: Greet Mary. She has worked very hard for you.

es.L: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a María, que se esforzó mucho por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a María, que ha trabajado mucho por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a María. Ha trabajado muchísimo por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

sw.L: Msalimieni Mariamu, ambaye alitaabika sana kwa ajili yenu.
sw.B: Msalimieni Mariamu, ambaye amefanya kazi kwa bidii kwa ajili yenu.
sw.R: Msalimieni Mariamu. Amefanya kazi kwa bidii sana kwa ajili yenu.

fr.L: Saluez Marie, qui a beaucoup peiné pour vous.
fr.B: Saluez Marie, qui a beaucoup travaillé pour vous.
fr.R: Saluez Marie. Elle a travaillé très dur pour vous.

ko.L: 여러분을 위하여 많이 수고한 마리아에게 문안하십시오.
ko.B: 여러분을 위해 많이 애쓴 마리아에게 문안하십시오.
ko.R: 마리아에게 안부를 전해 주십시오. 그는 여러분을 위해 아주 열심히 일했습니다.

vi.L: Hãy chào Ma-ri, người đã làm việc khó nhọc nhiều cho anh chị em.
vi.B: Xin chào thăm Ma-ri, người đã làm việc vất vả vì anh chị em.
vi.R: Hãy chào Ma-ri. Chị đã làm việc rất vất vả cho anh chị em.

pt.L: Saúdem Maria, que muito trabalhou por vocês.
pt.B: Saúdem Maria, que trabalhou muito por vocês.
pt.R: Saúdem Maria. Ela se esforçou muito por vocês.

am.L: ስለ እናንተ ብዙ የደከመችውን ማርያምን ሰላም በሉ።
am.B: ለእናንተ ብዙ የለፋችውን ማርያምን ሰላም በሉልኝ።
am.R: ማርያምን ሰላም በሉልኝ። እርሷ ለእናንተ እጅግ ደክማለች።

ru.L: Приветствуйте Марию, которая много трудилась для вас.
ru.B: Приветствуйте Марию, которая усердно трудилась ради вас.
ru.R: Приветствуйте Марию. Она очень много потрудилась для вас.

hi.B: मरियम को नमस्कार कहो, जिसने तुम्हारे लिए कड़ी मेहनत की है।

uk.L: Вітайте Марію, яка багато трудилася для вас.
uk.B: Вітайте Марію, яка багато працювала для вас.
uk.R: Привітайте Марію. Вона дуже багато працювала для вас.

ja.L: あなたがたのために多く労苦したマリアにあいさつしなさい。
ja.B: あなたがたのために大いに苦労して働いたマリアによろしく伝えてください。
ja.R: マリアによろしく伝えてください。マリアは、みなさんのために一生懸命働いてきました。

decisions.reason: The name is the Greek form of Miriam. Several women in the New Testament have it; nothing more is known of this Mary than what Paul says here.

decisions.choice: labored: hard work, here for the church
decisions.reason: κοπιάω means to work to the point of weariness. Paul uses it of his own work for the gospel and of others who work among believers (1 Corinthians 16:16, 1 Thessalonians 5:12).

Some manuscripts read "for us", and a few "among you". "For you" means her work was for the church in Rome. The SBLGNT reads "for you". (From general knowledge of the manuscripts; to be checked against the apparatus.)

decisions.choice: "làm việc khó nhọc" (L); "làm việc vất vả" (B, R) (also 16:12)
decisions.reason: The verb is hard, tiring work, here for the church (m2). "Vất vả" is the word of Colossians 4:13 (B).

decisions.choice: "労苦した" (L); "苦労して働いた" (B); "一生懸命働いてきました" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is work to the point of weariness (m2). The same choice is used for Tryphaena, Tryphosa and Persis (verse 12).

source.text: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀνδρόνικον καὶ Ἰουνίαν τοὺς συγγενεῖς μου καὶ συναιχμαλώτους μου, οἵτινές εἰσιν ἐπίσημοι ἐν τοῖς ἀποστόλοις, οἳ καὶ πρὸ ἐμοῦ γέγοναν ἐν Χριστῷ.

records.literal_gloss: Greet Andronicus and Junia the kinsfolk of me and fellow prisoners of me, who are notable among the apostles, who also before me have been in Christ.

en.L: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my kinsfolk and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who also were in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} before me.
en.B: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow Jews, who were in prison with me. They are prominent among the apostles, and they were in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} earlier than I was.
en.R: Greet Andronicus and Junia. They are Jews like me, and they were in prison with me. They stand out among the apostles. They belonged to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} even before I did.

es.L: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a Andrónico y a Junia, mis parientes y mis compañeros de prisión, que son notables entre los apóstoles, y que también estuvieron en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} antes que yo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a Andrónico y a Junia, mis compatriotas judíos, que estuvieron presos conmigo. Se destacan entre los apóstoles, y estuvieron en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} antes que yo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a Andrónico y a Junia. Son judíos como yo, y estuvieron en la cárcel conmigo. Sobresalen entre los apóstoles. Ya pertenecían {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} antes que yo.

sw.L: Wasalimieni Androniko na Yunia, jamaa zangu na wafungwa wenzangu, ambao ni mashuhuri miongoni mwa mitume, ambao pia walikuwa ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kabla yangu.
sw.B: Wasalimieni Androniko na Yunia, Wayahudi wenzangu, waliokuwa gerezani pamoja nami. Wao ni mashuhuri miongoni mwa mitume, na walikuwa ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} mapema kuliko mimi.
sw.R: Wasalimieni Androniko na Yunia. Wao ni Wayahudi kama mimi, na walikuwa gerezani pamoja nami. Wanajulikana sana miongoni mwa mitume. Walikuwa wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hata kabla yangu.

fr.L: Saluez Andronicus et Junia, mes compatriotes et mes compagnons de captivité, qui sont remarquables parmi les apôtres, et qui même ont été {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} avant moi.
fr.B: Saluez Andronicus et Junia, mes compatriotes juifs, qui ont été en prison avec moi. Ils sont éminents parmi les apôtres, et ils ont été {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} avant moi.
fr.R: Saluez Andronicus et Junia. Ce sont des Juifs comme moi, et ils ont été en prison avec moi. Ils se distinguent parmi les apôtres. Ils appartenaient au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} avant moi.

ko.L: 나의 동족이며 나와 함께 갇혔던 안드로니고와 유니아에게 문안하십시오. 그들은 사도들 가운데서 뛰어난 사람들이며, 나보다 먼저 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에 있었습니다.
ko.B: 나의 동족이며 나와 함께 감옥에 갇혔던 안드로니고와 유니아에게 문안하십시오. 그들은 사도들 가운데서 뛰어난 사람들이며, 나보다 먼저 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에 있었습니다.
ko.R: 안드로니고와 유니아에게 안부를 전해 주십시오. 그들은 나와 같은 유대인이고, 나와 함께 감옥에 갇혔던 사람들입니다. 그들은 사도들 가운데서도 두드러진 사람들입니다. 그들은 나보다 먼저 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 믿었습니다.

vi.L: Hãy chào An-trô-ni-cơ và Giu-ni-a, những bà con của tôi và những bạn đồng tù với tôi, là những người nổi danh trong vòng các sứ đồ, và cũng đã ở trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} trước tôi.
vi.B: Xin chào thăm An-trô-ni-cơ và Giu-ni-a, những đồng bào Do Thái của tôi, đã từng bị tù với tôi. Họ là những người nổi bật trong vòng các sứ đồ, và họ đã ở trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} trước tôi.
vi.R: Hãy chào An-trô-ni-cơ và Giu-ni-a. Họ là người Do Thái như tôi, và họ đã từng ở tù với tôi. Họ là những người nổi bật trong vòng các sứ đồ. Họ đã thuộc về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} còn trước cả tôi.

pt.L: Saúdem Andrônico e Júnia, meus parentes e meus companheiros de prisão, que são notáveis entre os apóstolos, que também estiveram {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} antes de mim.
pt.B: Saúdem Andrônico e Júnia, meus compatriotas judeus, que estiveram presos comigo. Eles se destacam entre os apóstolos e já estavam {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} antes de mim.
pt.R: Saúdem Andrônico e Júnia. Eles são judeus como eu e estiveram presos comigo. Eles se destacam entre os apóstolos. Eles já pertenciam {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}} antes de mim.

am.L: ዘመዶቼና አብረውኝ የታሰሩትን አንድሮኒቆስንና ዩልያንን ሰላም በሉ፤ እነርሱ በሐዋርያት መካከል የታወቁ ናቸው፤ ደግሞም ከእኔ በፊት {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ነበሩ።
am.B: አይሁዳውያን ወገኖቼ የሆኑትንና ከእኔ ጋር የታሰሩትን አንድሮኒቆስንና ዩልያንን ሰላም በሉልኝ። እነርሱ በሐዋርያት መካከል ታዋቂዎች ናቸው፤ ደግሞም ከእኔ ቀድመው {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ነበሩ።
am.R: አንድሮኒቆስንና ዩልያንን ሰላም በሉልኝ። እንደ እኔ አይሁድ ናቸው፤ ከእኔም ጋር ታስረው ነበር። በሐዋርያት መካከል ተለይተው የታወቁ ናቸው። {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} የሆኑት ከእኔ በፊት ነው።

ru.L: Приветствуйте Андроника и Юнию, моих сородичей и моих сотоварищей по заключению, которые известны среди апостолов, которые и прежде меня были {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}}.
ru.B: Приветствуйте Андроника и Юнию, моих соплеменников-иудеев, которые были в заключении вместе со мной. Они выдающиеся среди апостолов, и они были {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} раньше, чем я.
ru.R: Приветствуйте Андроника и Юнию. Они иудеи, как и я, и они сидели в тюрьме вместе со мной. Среди апостолов они выделяются. Они принадлежали {{christos:Христу|Мессии}} ещё до того, как я поверил.

hi.L: अन्द्रुनीकुस और यूनिया को, जो मेरे कुटुंबी और मेरे साथ बंदी रहे हैं, नमस्कार कहो, जो प्रेरितों में नामी हैं, और मुझसे पहले मसीह में हुए।
hi.B: अन्द्रुनीकुस और यूनिया को नमस्कार कहो, जो मेरे साथी यहूदी हैं और मेरे साथ बंदीगृह में रहे। वे प्रेरितों में प्रसिद्ध हैं, और मुझसे पहले मसीह में आए थे।
hi.R: अन्द्रुनीकुस और यूनिया को नमस्कार कहना। वे मेरी तरह यहूदी हैं, और वे मेरे साथ जेल में रहे थे। प्रेरितों में उनका नाम बहुत ऊँचा है। वे मुझसे भी पहले मसीह के हो गए थे।

uk.L: Вітайте Андроника і Юнію, моїх родичів і моїх співвʼязнів, які визначні серед апостолів, які й раніше від мене були {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}}.
uk.B: Вітайте Андроника і Юнію, моїх співвітчизників-юдеїв, які були разом зі мною у вʼязниці. Вони визначні серед апостолів і були {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} раніше, ніж я.
uk.R: Привітайте Андроника і Юнію. Вони юдеї, як і я, і вони сиділи разом зі мною у вʼязниці. Вони вирізняються серед апостолів. Вони належали {{christos:Христові|Месії}} ще раніше, ніж я.

ja.L: わたしの同族で、わたしと共に捕らわれの身となったアンドロニコとユニアにあいさつしなさい。彼らは使徒たちの中で際立っている者たちで、わたしより前に{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}にある者となりました。
ja.B: わたしと同じユダヤ人で、わたしと一緒に牢に入れられたアンドロニコとユニアによろしく伝えてください。二人は使徒たちの中で際立っており、わたしよりも先に{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}に結ばれた人たちです。
ja.R: アンドロニコとユニアによろしく伝えてください。二人はわたしと同じユダヤ人で、わたしといっしょに牢に入れられていました。二人は使徒たちの中でも、特に目立つ人たちです。わたしよりも前に、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}と一つにされていました。

decisions.reason: The earliest manuscripts were written without accents, so Ἰουνίαν could be read as the woman's name Junia or as a man's name Junias. Junia was a common Latin name for women; a man's name Junias has not been found anywhere else. Early Christian writers who comment on the verse took Junia as a woman, and the SBLGNT accents the word as a woman's name. A few manuscripts have Julia, the name in verse 15. Andronicus and Junia were probably a married couple, like Prisca and Aquila. (From general knowledge of the manuscripts; to be checked against the apparatus.)

συγγενής can mean a relative, but Paul uses it for his fellow Israelites in 9:3, and he gives it to six people in this chapter (verses 7, 11, 21). They are most likely Jews like him rather than members of his family.

decisions.choice: fellow prisoners: they had been in prison with Paul
decisions.reason: The word is literally "fellow captives". Paul was imprisoned many times (2 Corinthians 11:23); where these two shared a prison with him is not known.

decisions.choice: prominent among the apostles: they were themselves counted as apostles
alternatives: well known to the apostles: respected by the apostles, but not apostles themselves
decisions.reason: "Among" with a group of people usually places someone inside the group, so the phrase most naturally means that they were outstanding apostles. "Apostle" here would have the wider sense of a messenger sent out to plant churches, as with Barnabas (Acts 14:14) and the messengers of the churches (2 Corinthians 8:23), not one of the Twelve. Others read it as "well known to the apostles", since the word for "notable" can be followed by the people to whom someone is known. Both readings are possible Greek.

decisions.choice: they became believers before Paul did
decisions.reason: "Were in Christ before me" means they belonged to Christ before Paul's own conversion, so they were among the earliest believers, perhaps from Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: kinsfolk (L); fellow Jews (B); Jews like me (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the word that covers both family and people; Balanced and Readable say which is meant (meaning decision m2). "Countrymen" would leave out Junia.
Title setting.
Older Spanish Bibles print the masculine "Junias". Following meaning decision m1, Spanish gives the woman's name "Junia", which is also the usual Spanish form of the Latin name.

decisions.choice: mes compatriotes (L); mes compatriotes juifs (B); des Juifs comme moi (R) (also 16:11, 16:21)
decisions.reason: The word means fellow Jews (meaning decision). French "mes parents" would be read first as "my father and mother", so even Literal says "compatriotes".
The SBLGNT accents the name as the woman's name Junia (meaning decision, footnoted); "유니아" is the Protestant Korean form.

decisions.choice: "동족" (L, B); "나와 같은 유대인" (R), here and in verses 11 and 21
decisions.reason: The word means fellow Jews here (meaning decision); Korean "친척" would say they were Paul's relatives.

decisions.choice: "사도들 가운데서 뛰어난 사람들" (L, B); "사도들 가운데서도 두드러진 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision (footnoted) reads this as prominent among the apostles, themselves counted as apostles; "가운데서" places them in that group.
The meaning decision reads the name as Junia, a woman (footnoted). "Giu-ni-a" is the traditional form of that name.

decisions.choice: "bà con" (L); "đồng bào Do Thái" (B); "người Do Thái như tôi" (R) for kinsfolk (also 16:11, 16:21)
decisions.reason: Kinsfolk here are fellow Jews (m2). Literal keeps the word for relatives; Balanced uses "đồng bào" of 9:3 and names the people, as the English Balanced says "fellow Jews".

decisions.choice: "nổi danh" (L), "nổi bật" (B, R) "trong vòng các sứ đồ"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads this as prominent among the apostles, counted as apostles themselves (footnoted). "Trong vòng các sứ đồ" places them within the group; "được các sứ đồ biết đến" would choose the other reading.

decisions.choice: Júnia; meus parentes (L), meus compatriotas judeus (B), judeus como eu (R)
decisions.reason: Júnia is the Brazilian form of the woman's name m1 reads, as the English "Junia". "Parentes" in Portuguese means family, so only Literal keeps it, as the English Literal keeps "kinsfolk"; Balanced says "compatriotas", a noun for men and women alike, so that Júnia is included (m2). The same words serve in verses 11 and 21.

alternatives: a spelling closer to the Greek or Latin form
decisions.reason: These are the forms of the Amharic Bible tradition. The meaning decision reads Junia as a woman; "ዩልያን" does not show gender in itself, and it is close to "ዩልያ" (Julia, verse 15), whose object form is also "ዩልያን". A reviewer may prefer "ዩንያ", nearer the Greek.
The meaning decision takes Junia as a woman; Russian says so in the name's ending.
Kinsfolk here means fellow Jews (meaning decision m2), as in 9:3; Literal keeps the word that covers family and people, Balanced and Readable say which is meant. The same holds in verses 11 and 21.
Junia is a woman's name (meaning decision m1); the Hindi keeps the feminine form.
The text reads the woman's name Junia (meaning decision m1); Ukrainian shows the gender in the ending, so "Юнію" (accusative of Юнія) and not a man's name.

decisions.choice: "アンドロニコ" for Andronicus; "ユニア" for Junia
decisions.reason: Transliterations in the pattern of this chapter. The SBLGNT accents the second name as the woman's name Junia (m1), so Japanese writes "ユニア", not the masculine "ユニアス".

decisions.choice: "同族" (L); "わたしと同じユダヤ人" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word can mean relatives but here most likely means fellow Jews (m2). Literal keeps "同族", which covers both family and people; Balanced and Readable say which is meant, as the English does. The same choice holds in verses 11 and 21.

source.text: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀμπλιᾶτον τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου ἐν κυρίῳ.

records.literal_gloss: Greet Ampliatus the beloved of me in [the] Lord.

decisions.reason: The Greek says only "those from the [people] of Aristobulus". In a Roman household this means mainly the slaves and freed slaves who belonged to it. Aristobulus himself is not greeted, so he may not have been a believer, or may have died.

decisions.choice: Aristobulus: perhaps a member of Herod's family living in Rome

The Greek leaves the noun out; "household" is what the phrase means (meaning decision m1).

The members of a household (m1), which took in servants and freed slaves as well as kin; "nhà" covers all of them, where "gia đình" would suggest relatives only.

alternatives: a spelling closer to the Greek or Latin form
decisions.reason: The name is given in the form it is thought to have in the Ethiopian Bible tradition, or, where no form is known, spelled from the Greek in the way that tradition spells such names. The spelling is not certain and should be checked by an Amharic reviewer.

ru.L: Приветствуйте Персиду возлюбленную, которая много потрудилась в Господе.

ru.R: Приветствуйте нашу дорогую подругу Персиду. Она очень много потрудилась для Господа.

hi.L: प्रिय पिरसिस को नमस्कार कहो, जिसने प्रभु में बहुत परिश्रम किया।

uk.R: Привітайте нашу дорогу подругу Персиду. Вона дуже багато працювала для Господа.

ja.L: 主にあって多く労苦した、愛されているペルシスにあいさつしなさい。
ja.B: 主に結ばれて大いに苦労して働いた、愛するペルシスに、よろしく伝えてください。
ja.R: わたしたちの親しい友ペルシスによろしく伝えてください。ペルシスは、主のために一生懸命働きました。

decisions.choice: the beloved: dear to the whole church
decisions.reason: With the men in verses 5, 8 and 9 Paul writes "my beloved"; here he writes "the beloved", dear to all the believers.

decisions.choice: she labored: her work in the past
decisions.reason: Paul uses the past tense for Persis where he used the present for Tryphaena and Tryphosa. Her hard work may have been earlier; the text does not say why.
Readable says "our", for the shared affection the article implies (meaning decision m1).
As in 12a.
Here Paul does not say "my": she is dear to the whole church (meaning decision).

alternatives: a spelling closer to the Greek or Latin form
decisions.reason: The name is given in the form it is thought to have in the Ethiopian Bible tradition, or, where no form is known, spelled from the Greek in the way that tradition spells such names. The spelling is not certain and should be checked by an Amharic reviewer.
A transliteration of the Greek form of the name in the pattern of modern ecumenical Japanese usage; noted once where the name appears.
Here Paul writes "the beloved", not "my beloved" as with the men in verses 5, 8 and 9 (m1): Persis is dear to all. Literal says "愛されている"; Balanced "愛する" without "わたしの"; Readable "わたしたちの親しい友".

records.literal_gloss: Greet Rufus the chosen [one] in [the] Lord, and the mother of him and of me.

en.L: Greet Rufus, the chosen [one] in [the] Lord, and his mother and mine.
en.B: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and greet his mother, who has also been a mother to me.
en.R: Greet Rufus, whom the Lord has chosen. Greet his mother too. She has been like a mother to me.

es.L: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a Rufo, el escogido en [el] Señor, y a su madre y mía.
es.B: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a Rufo, escogido en el Señor, y {{plural_you:saluden|saludad}} a su madre, que también ha sido una madre para mí.
es.R: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a Rufo, a quien el Señor ha escogido. {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} también a su madre. Ella ha sido como una madre para mí.

sw.L: Wasalimieni Rufo, mteule katika Bwana, na mama yake na wangu.

fr.L: Saluez Rufus, l’élu dans [le] Seigneur, et sa mère et [la] mienne.
fr.B: Saluez Rufus, choisi dans le Seigneur, et saluez sa mère, qui a été une mère pour moi aussi.
fr.R: Saluez Rufus, que le Seigneur a choisi. Saluez aussi sa mère. Elle a été comme une mère pour moi.

ko.L: 주님 안에서 택함을 받은 루포와 그의 어머니에게 문안하십시오. 그 어머니는 나의 [어머니이기도 합니다].
ko.B: 주님 안에서 택함을 받은 루포에게 문안하고, 그의 어머니에게도 문안하십시오. 그 어머니는 나에게도 어머니가 되어 주었습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 택하신 루포에게 안부를 전해 주십시오. 그의 어머니에게도 안부를 전해 주십시오. 그분은 나에게 어머니와 같은 분이었습니다.

vi.L: Hãy chào Ru-phu, người được chọn trong Chúa, và mẹ anh ấy, cũng là mẹ tôi.
vi.B: Xin chào thăm Ru-phu, người được chọn trong Chúa, và chào mẹ anh ấy, người cũng đã là mẹ đối với tôi.
vi.R: Hãy chào Ru-phu, người Chúa đã chọn. Cũng hãy chào mẹ anh ấy. Bà đã đối xử với tôi như một người mẹ.

pt.L: Saúdem Rufo, o escolhido no Senhor, e a mãe dele e minha.
pt.B: Saúdem Rufo, escolhido no Senhor, e saúdem a mãe dele, que também tem sido uma mãe para mim.
pt.R: Saúdem Rufo, que o Senhor escolheu. Saúdem também a mãe dele. Ela tem sido como uma mãe para mim.

am.L: በጌታ የተመረጠውን ሩፎስን፣ የእርሱንና የእኔንም እናት ሰላም በሉ።

hi.L: रूफ़ुस को, जो प्रभु में चुना हुआ है, और उसकी और मेरी माता को नमस्कार कहो।
hi.B: रूफ़ुस को, जो प्रभु में चुना हुआ है, नमस्कार कहो, और उसकी माता को भी, जो मेरे लिए भी माँ रही है।

uk.L: Вітайте Руфа, вибраного в Господі, і його матір, і мою.
uk.B: Вітайте Руфа, вибраного в Господі, і його матір, яка була матірʼю і для мене.
uk.R: Привітайте Руфа, якого вибрав Господь. Привітайте і його матір. Вона була для мене як мати.

ja.L: 主にあって選ばれた者ルフォスと、彼の母であり、わたしの[母でもある人]にあいさつしなさい。
ja.B: 主に結ばれた、選ばれた人ルフォスに、よろしく伝えてください。また、その母にもよろしく伝えてください。この人は、わたしにとっても母です。
ja.R: ルフォスによろしく伝えてください。主が選ばれた人です。ルフォスのお母さんにも、よろしく伝えてください。わたしにとっても、お母さんのような人です。

decisions.reason: ἐκλεκτός means chosen, and in Paul it describes all believers as chosen by God (8:33). Said of one man, it may stress that he is an outstanding believer, a "choice" man. The levels keep "chosen".

decisions.choice: his mother, who has also mothered Paul
decisions.reason: "His mother and mine" means she had cared for Paul as if he were her own son, not that Paul and Rufus were brothers.

decisions.choice: Rufus: perhaps the son of Simon of Cyrene
decisions.reason: Mark 15:21 names Simon of Cyrene, who carried Jesus' cross, as "the father of Alexander and Rufus", as if the readers knew them. If Mark wrote for believers in Rome, this may be the same Rufus. The name was common, so this is uncertain.

decisions.choice: who has also been a mother to me (B); She has been like a mother to me (R)
decisions.reason: Spelled out so the phrase is not read as Paul's own mother (meaning decision m2).
Readable makes the Lord the one who chose. In Paul God chooses (8:33), and Rufus belongs to the Lord; the sense is the same.
The same Korean form as the Rufus of Mark 15:21, whom the meaning decision mentions.
Korean speaks of an older woman who has been like a mother with respect; the honorific here is ordinary courtesy, not the honorific for God.
This may be the son of Simon of Cyrene (m3), so the name is spelled as in Mark, where the reader may meet him first.
The same spelling as Mark 15:21, where a Rufus is named as the son of Simon of Cyrene (meaning decision m3).
A transliteration of the Greek form of the name in the pattern of modern ecumenical Japanese usage; noted once where the name appears.

decisions.choice: a group of believers, perhaps a house church
decisions.reason: Five men are named together with "the brothers with them", which suggests a group that met together, perhaps in one house or among the workers of one household. Several of the names were common among slaves and freed slaves.
ἀδελφός is Paul's usual word for fellow members of the church, including the women among them, as in 1:13.
No particular men are meant, so the inclusive default applies.
Readable says how they were "with them": as a group that met together (meaning decision m1).

As in Romans 1:13, Spanish "hermanos" already covers brothers and sisters, so there is no gender span. For review: this chapter greets many women by name, and a reviewer may prefer to make the women explicit.

alternatives: ndugu wa kiume na wa kike
decisions.reason: As in Romans 1:13, "ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, so Swahili needs no gender span.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:형제자매|형제}}들" at every level, as settled at 1:13
decisions.reason: Fellow believers, men and women (meaning decision).

alternatives: a spelling closer to the Greek or Latin form
decisions.reason: The name is given in the form it is thought to have in the Ethiopian Bible tradition, or, where no form is known, spelled from the Greek in the way that tradition spells such names. The spelling is not certain and should be checked by an Amharic reviewer.

decisions.choice: traditional Russian forms of the names
decisions.reason: The names in this chapter take their traditional Russian Bible forms (Епенет, Амплий, Стахий, Аристовул, Ерм, Патров, Ермий), which are not copyrighted, so that readers can find them in other Bibles.
The guide's oblique span for adelphoi meaning the believers, men and women (section 7b), matching the English. The same holds in verse 17 in the vocative.
Two different names in the Greek; the modern spellings of the traditional forms keep them apart.

decisions.choice: "アシンクリト", "フレゴン", "ヘルメス", "パトロバ", "ヘルマス"
decisions.reason: Transliterations in the pattern of this chapter's names. "ヘルメス" and "ヘルマス" are kept distinct, as the Greek names are; "パトロバ" is the conventional form.

am.L: ፊሎሎጎስንና ዩልያን፣ ኔርያንና እኅቱን፣ ኦሊምጳስንም ከእነርሱም ጋር ያሉትን ቅዱሳን ሁሉ ሰላም በሉ።

hi.L: फ़िलुलुगुस और यूलिया, नेर्युस और उसकी बहन, और उलुम्पास, और उनके साथ के सब पवित्र जनों को नमस्कार कहो।

uk.L: Вітайте Филолога і Юлію, Нірея і його сестру, і Олімпана, і всіх святих, що з ними.
uk.B: Вітайте Филолога і Юлію, Нірея і його сестру, і Олімпана, і всіх святих, які з ними.
uk.R: Привітайте Филолога і Юлію, Нірея і його сестру, і Олімпана. Привітайте також увесь Божий народ, який із ними.

ja.L: フィロロゴとユリア、ネレウスとその姉妹、またオリンパ、そして彼らと共にいるすべての聖なる者たちにあいさつしなさい。
ja.B: フィロロゴとユリア、ネレウスとその姉妹、オリンパ、そして彼らと一緒にいる神の聖なる民のすべての人に、よろしく伝えてください。
ja.R: フィロロゴとユリア、ネレウスとその姉妹、そしてオリンパに、よろしく伝えてください。また、この人たちといっしょにいる、神の民のみんなにも、よろしく伝えてください。

decisions.choice: another group of believers, perhaps a family
decisions.reason: Philologus and Julia are named as a pair, probably husband and wife or brother and sister; Nereus and his sister may have been their children. With "all the holy ones with them" they seem to be another group that met together.
As in verse 2 and 1:7: all believers, set apart as God's own.

decisions.choice: holy ones (L); God's holy people (B); God's people (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

decisions.choice: "성도" (L, B); "하나님의 거룩한 백성" (R), as settled at 1:1
decisions.reason: Holy ones: believers (meaning decision).
Vietnamese kinship words say whether a sister is older or younger, which the Greek does not; "chị em gái" leaves it open.

alternatives: a spelling closer to the Greek or Latin form
decisions.reason: The name is given in the form it is thought to have in the Ethiopian Bible tradition, or, where no form is known, spelled from the Greek in the way that tradition spells such names. The spelling is not certain and should be checked by an Amharic reviewer. Julia ("ዩልያ") must be kept distinct from Junia ("ዩልያን", verse 7).

decisions.choice: "पवित्र जन" (L); "परमेश्वर के पवित्र लोग" (B); "परमेश्वर के लोग" (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 2 and in Acts: the holy ones are all believers (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "フィロロゴ", "ユリア", "ネレウス", "オリンパ"
decisions.reason: Transliterations in the pattern of this chapter's names. "ユリア" is the Latin woman's name Julia.

decisions.choice: the kiss of greeting among believers
decisions.reason: A kiss was a common greeting among family and close friends. Paul calls it holy: the greeting of people who are now one family in God. He asks for it in other letters too (1 Corinthians 16:20, 2 Corinthians 13:12, 1 Thessalonians 5:26).
The kiss of greeting among believers (meaning decision); the custom is kept, not replaced by a modern one.
The kiss of greeting among believers (m1) is kept as it was, at every level, as the English does; replacing it with a modern gesture would change what Paul asked.

A kiss was the greeting of family and close friends (m1). Japanese keeps the custom as Paul names it rather than replacing it with a Japanese greeting; "口づけ" is the plain word, and "接吻" is old-fashioned.

Title setting.
The word the Vietnamese Colossians uses for a church (4:15-16), capitalised as Vietnamese churches write it.

decisions.choice: "ሰላም ይሏችኋል" (L); "ሰላምታ ይልኩላችኋል" (send you greetings, B, R) for 'greet you'
decisions.reason: Greetings passed on from people elsewhere are said in Amharic as 'they send you greetings'. Literal keeps 'they say peace to you'. The same holds in verses 21-23.

records.literal_gloss: I urge now you, brothers, to watch the [ones] the divisions and the stumbling blocks contrary to the teaching which you learned causing, and turn away from them;

en.L: Now I urge you, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, to watch out for those who cause the divisions and the stumbling blocks contrary to the teaching that you learned, and turn away from them;
en.B: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, I urge you to keep an eye on those who stir up divisions and put stumbling blocks in people's way, against the teaching you were taught. Keep away from them.
en.R: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, I beg you to watch out for people who split the church apart. They make others trip up and fall away from the teaching you learned. Stay away from them.

es.L: Ahora bien, {{plural_you:les|os}} ruego, hermanos, que {{plural_you:vigilen|vigiléis}} a quienes provocan las divisiones y las piedras de tropiezo contrarias a la enseñanza que {{plural_you:ustedes aprendieron|vosotros aprendisteis}}, y {{plural_you:apártense|apartaos}} de ellos;
es.B: Hermanos, {{plural_you:les|os}} ruego que {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} los ojos puestos en quienes fomentan divisiones y ponen obstáculos en el camino de otros, en contra de la enseñanza que {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}}. {{plural_you:Apártense|Apartaos}} de ellos.

sw.L: Basi nawasihi, ndugu, mwaangalie wale wanaosababisha mafarakano na vikwazo kinyume cha mafundisho ambayo ninyi mliyajifunza, na jiepusheni nao;
